facts.fact: The DGSN's 2025 annual review, as La Vie éco reports it, says the Qadaya computer system networks the police services so that cases of misdemeanours and crimes are handled quickly and in real time.

The DGSN's 2025 review says the generalisation of Qadaya continued in 2025 to cover 16 of the 22 police commands (commandements de sûreté) nationally, with national generalisation in view; it gives no count of arrondissements or stations.
The DGSN's 2025 review says Qadaya's rollout continued during 2025 and reached 16 of 22 police commands, towards national coverage.
The DGSN's 2025 review presents Qadaya as a system the DGSN itself is generalising across its commands, within services its own technical and engineering teams develop.
